title: Greek Evening Avgolemono Soup
description: A traditional Greek soup made with chicken, egg, and lemon, perfect for a chilly evening. This avgolemono soup is a classic comfort food.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic in a little bit of oil until softened.
2. Add the chicken and cook until browned.
3. Stir in the cumin, dried peas, and chicken broth.
4. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Using an immersion blender, puree the soup until smooth.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and egg yolks.
7. Stir the egg mixture into the soup and cook for 1 minute.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
